paper_record.title: Thermal spin transport in easy-planar $d$-wave altermagnets controlled by magnetic field
paper_record.abstract: Altermagnets constitute a novel class of collinear spin-compensated materials in which magnon branches are spin-split even in the non-relativistic limit. The latter is the result of a more complex symmetry operation (compared to conventional antiferromagnets) that connects the two sublattices. Altermagnetic splitting strongly affects the magnon transport properties, leading, in particular, to the thermal magnon splitter effect in easy-axial $d$-wave altermagnets. Whether this effect also appears in easy-planar systems is not obvious, since the magnon branches do not carry a constant magnetic moment in this case. Here, we consider the easy-planar $d$-wave altermagnet of a rutile-type, e.g., NiF$_2$, and demonstrate the emergence of the altermagnetically generated magnon magnetic moment, which is momentum-dependent and possesses $d$-wave symmetry. This then leads to the spin-splitter effect, i.e., the emergence of a magnon-driven spin current (the flow of magnetic moment) in response to the applied temperature gradient. We also demonstrate that the corresponding thermal spin conductivity can be effectively tuned by an external magnetic field perpendicular to the easy plane.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 本文研究了易面d波交错磁体中的热自旋输运，并展示了如何利用垂直于易面的外磁场有效调控自旋分裂效应。
one_sentence_summary.en: This work studies thermal spin transport in easy-planar d-wave altermagnets and demonstrates that the spin-splitter effect can be effectively tuned by an out-of-plane magnetic field.

problem.zh: 探究在易面d波交错磁体（如NiF2）中，交错磁性如何诱导动量相关的磁子磁矩，以及如何实现可调控的热自旋输运。
problem.en: Investigating how altermagnetism induces momentum-dependent magnon magnetic moments in easy-planar d-wave systems (like NiF2) and how to achieve tunable thermal spin transport.

approach.zh: 基于二维金红石型交错磁体模型，结合自旋波理论、半经典玻尔兹曼输运理论以及自旋晶格动力学模拟进行理论推导与数值验证。
approach.en: Utilizing a 2D rutile-type altermagnet model combined with spin-wave theory, semi-classical Boltzmann transport theory, and spin-lattice dynamics simulations for theoretical derivation and numerical verification.

main_takeaway.zh: 易面各向异性与d波交错磁性的结合产生了一种动量相关的磁子磁矩，从而引发热自旋分裂效应；该效应产生的自旋电导率可以通过外加垂直磁场进行显著调控甚至改变方向。
main_takeaway.en: The combination of easy-planar anisotropy and d-wave altermagnetism generates a momentum-dependent magnon magnetic moment, driving a thermal spin-splitter effect that can be significantly tuned or even reversed by an external perpendicular magnetic field.

why_it_matters.zh: 它为在绝缘体中利用热流产生和调控自旋电流提供了新机制，将交错磁子学拓展到易面系统，并提供了一种磁场调控自旋输运的有效手段。
why_it_matters.en: It provides a new mechanism for generating and manipulating spin currents using heat in insulators, extending altermagnonics to easy-planar systems and offering an effective method for magnetic-field control of spin transport.

reason.zh: 首次将热自旋分裂效应推广到易面d波交错磁体系统，并提出了利用外磁场调控自旋流的物理机制。
reason.en: It extends the thermal spin-splitter effect to easy-planar d-wave altermagnets and proposes a physical mechanism to control spin currents via an external magnetic field.

reason.zh: 交错磁性是当前凝聚态物理的热点，该工作提出了新颖的磁场调控热自旋输运机制，非常适合发表在PRL上。
reason.en: Altermagnetism is a highly active topic in condensed matter physics, and this work proposes a novel magnetic-field control mechanism for thermal spin transport, making it highly suitable for PRL.
